title: Enquiry
description: Log customer enquiries and convert to job cards.

whatsapp.panelDescription: Send a pre-filled WhatsApp message to the customer with their enquiry details.
whatsapp.setupStep2: Tap the link button below to launch WhatsApp with pre-filled message
whatsapp.setupStep3: Review the message and tap Send
